The Battle of Oslo () is an upcoming Norwegian historical–war thriller film directed by  Daniel Fahre. The film is set on 9 April 1940, during the German invasion of Norway. It follows Colonel Birger Eriksen at Oscarsborg Fortress and the sinking of the German cruiser Blücher.
The film also depicts , led by Erik Solem, played by , and naval member Per Askim, played by Jon Øigarden. It shifts between the intense events at Oscarsborg and the overlooked proceedings of 1946, where Eriksen is summoned to justify his actions before a military inquiry. It will open the 53rd Norwegian International Film Festival on 17 August 2025 and have its premiere in Main Programme.
It is slated to release in Norwegian theaters on 26 September 2025.
Cast
* Bjørn Sundquist as Colonel Birger Eriksen
* Jon Øigarden as Per Askim
* Terje Strømdahl as Erik Solem
* Øystein Røger as Commander Captain Andreas Anderssen
* Axel Bøyum as Ensign Sigurd Bexrud
* Fridtjov Såheim as Lieutenant August Bonsak
* Odin Waage as Berntsen
* Mads Ousdal as Major General Jacob Hvinden Haug
* Andrea Berntzen as Borghild Eriksen
* Eldar Skar as captain Magnus Sødem
Production
The filming began on 9 April 2024 at the authentic locations in the Oscarsborg Fortress
Weapons from 1916 were used to shoot the film.
Release
The Battle of Oslo is scheduled to open 53rd Norwegian International Film Festival on 17 August 2025. A public outdoor screening of the film will take place  at the Oscarsborg Fortress on 15 August 2025 before its premiere at the festival.
